# Public Site Maintainer

Use this skill for FAQ, guides, privacy drafts, changelog and roadmap.

## Required process

1. Read the app's current release and product specifications.
2. Identify which public documents are affected.
3. Preserve stable FAQ and roadmap IDs.
4. Update German and English versions or explicitly report a gap.
5. Avoid internal security details and personal data.
6. Run the public-site validator.
7. Never set legal or privacy approval metadata.
